Select and manage owner’s engineers, specialty contractors, and other members of the owner’s site team. Candidates without the stated formal education may be considered with at least 10 years of relevant construction experience and demonstrated competency for the role. Ability to use project management and other industry-standard technology and software. Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities in a highly dynamic environment. Field construction experience is preferred. Ability to travel approximately 25–50% annually, primarily within North America, to support active projects. Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary internal teams and with external contractors and stakeholders. The expected starting pay range for this role is $103,000 USD - $138,000 USD. This range is an estimate and base pay may be above or below the ranges based on several factors including but not limited to location, work experience, certifications, and education. In addition to base pay, Pattern’s compensation program includes a bonus structure for full-time employees of all levels.
